name: RequestGuard
purpose: Predicate invoked before a handler runs that returns allow/deny based on RequestContext and CurrentPrincipal, short-circuiting the pipeline on deny.
invariants: A False return MUST prevent the handler from running and SHALL produce a 401/403 response.
Guards MUST NOT mutate the request body; they CANNOT transform payloads, only accept or reject.
Multiple guards MUST be composed with logical AND: any False blocks the request.
Guards MUST execute before interceptors/pipes but after authentication middleware has bound a principal.
A guard that raises NEVER gets silently treated as allow; exceptions SHALL map to 500 by the error filter.
extension_contract: Downstream tools implement RequestGuard and register via a decorator (e.g. @UseGuards on a controller, a register() call on the pipeline, or a Plug inserted before dispatch); guards compose, they CANNOT replace one another.

sources.locator: docs.nestjs.com/guards — canActivate(context) returns boolean | Promise | Observable

why_essential: Authorization must be declarative and uniform across handlers; when each handler reimplements role checks, audit coverage CANNOT be proven and policy changes SHALL ripple unsafely.
alternatives_considered: Inline role checks in handlers — no central audit, easy to forget
Single monolithic authorization middleware — cannot attach different policies per route
Decorator metadata only — requires a reader and still needs a guard to enforce
